traditions.name: Ufology and contactee movements
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1947 CE (Kenneth Arnold sighting); contactee claims from 1952
traditions.scholarly_note: Belief in benevolent or sinister visitors from space spread after the 1947 sightings. The 1950s contactees (Adamski, Van Tassel, Bethurum) reported Venusian "Space Brothers"; from the 1960s abduction narratives (Betty and Barney Hill, 1961) centred on the small grey beings. Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996), treats UFO channeling as a strand of the New Age milieu.

traditions.name: Raëlism (Raëlian Movement)
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Claude Vorilhon (Raël) after a reported encounter of 13 December 1973; an atheist movement that reads the Bible as a record of extraterrestrial scientists.

traditions.name: Heaven's Gate
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Marshall Applewhite (Do) and Bonnie Lu Nettles (Ti); ended with the deaths of 39 members at Rancho Santa Fe, California, in March 1997.

traditions.name: Scientology
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by L. Ron Hubbard. Its upper-level Operating Thetan (OT) materials are confidential within the church; the OT III narrative entered the public record through court filings in the 1980s and 1990s, including the 1993 Fishman affidavit.

traditions.name: Nation of Islam
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Wallace Fard Muhammad in 1930 and led by Elijah Muhammad from 1934 to 1975; revived under Louis Farrakhan from 1977–1981. Its theology differs sharply from Sunni Islam.

traditions.name: Moorish Science Temple of America
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Noble Drew Ali (Timothy Drew). Its Circle Seven Koran (1927) draws heavily on Levi Dowling's Aquarian Gospel of Jesus the Christ (1908) and the Rosicrucian text Unto Thee I Grant.

traditions.name: Five-Percent Nation (Nation of Gods and Earths)
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Clarence 13X (Clarence Smith), who left the Nation of Islam in 1963–1964.

traditions.name: Black Hebrew Israelites
traditions.scholarly_note: A family of movements, from William Saunders Crowdy's Church of God and Saints of Christ (1896) to the African Hebrew Israelites of Jerusalem (Ben Ammi, 1960s) and the street "camps" such as Israel United in Christ; names and theology of God vary between groups.

traditions.name: Aetherius Society
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by George King after a reported command from the "Interplanetary Parliament" in May 1954.

traditions.name: Unarius Academy of Science
traditions.geographic_origin: Los Angeles, later El Cajon, California
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Ernest L. Norman and Ruth E. Norman (Uriel).

traditions.name: Ashtar Command
traditions.scholarly_note: First reported by contactee George Van Tassel in 1952; later carried by many channelers.

traditions.name: FIGU / Billy Meier contacts
traditions.scholarly_note: Swiss contactee Eduard "Billy" Meier reported contacts with Plejaren (Pleiadian) beings from January 1975; FIGU founded in the late 1970s.

traditions.name: The Urantia Book movement
traditions.scholarly_note: The Urantia Book was published by the Urantia Foundation in 1955; readers regard its 196 papers as a revelation from celestial authors.

traditions.name: Ancient-astronaut belief
traditions.scholarly_note: Readings of ancient myth and monuments as records of extraterrestrial visitors. Not an organized church but a widely held belief system; academic Assyriologists and Egyptologists reject its readings of the sources.

traditions.name: Law of One (Ra Material)
traditions.scholarly_note: Channeled sessions 1981–1984 by Carla Rueckert, Don Elkins and Jim McCarty (L/L Research), published as The Law of One (1982) and The Ra Material (1984) and The Law of One.

traditions.name: Tenrikyo
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded through the revelation to Nakayama Miki on 26 October 1838.

traditions.name: Oomoto
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded through the revelations to Deguchi Nao (1892) and systematized by Deguchi Onisaburo; suppressed by the Japanese state in 1921 and 1935.

traditions.name: Konkokyo
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Akazawa Bunji (Konko Daijin) in 1859.

traditions.name: Seicho-no-Ie
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Taniguchi Masaharu, a former Oomoto member influenced by American New Thought.

traditions.name: Cheondoism (Donghak)
traditions.scholarly_note: Donghak ("Eastern Learning") founded by Choe Je-u in 1860; renamed Cheondogyo in 1905 by Son Byong-hi.

traditions.name: Jeungsanism
traditions.scholarly_note: The family of movements (Jeung San Do, Daesoon Jinrihoe and others) that venerate Kang Il-sun (Jeungsan, 1871–1909) as the Supreme God incarnate.

traditions.name: Won Buddhism
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Sotaesan (Pak Chung-bin) after his enlightenment in 1916; named Wonbulgyo in 1947.

traditions.name: Falun Gong (Falun Dafa)
traditions.scholarly_note: Introduced by Li Hongzhi in 1992; banned in the People's Republic of China since 1999.

traditions.name: Unification Church (Family Federation)
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Sun Myung Moon as the Holy Spirit Association for the Unification of World Christianity; its doctrine is set out in the Divine Principle.

traditions.name: Eckankar
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Paul Twitchell, who had earlier studied with Kirpal Singh's Ruhani Satsang (Sant Mat); much of its cosmology adapts Sant Mat terms.

traditions.name: Faithism (Oahspe)
traditions.scholarly_note: Oahspe: A New Bible was produced by John Ballou Newbrough by automatic typewriting and published in 1882; followers are called Faithists.

traditions.name: Meher Baba movement
traditions.scholarly_note: Followers ("Baba lovers") of Meher Baba (Merwan Sheriar Irani, 1894–1969).

traditions.name: Sai Baba movements
traditions.scholarly_note: Devotion to Sai Baba of Shirdi (d. 1918) and to Sathya Sai Baba of Puttaparthi (1926–2011), who declared himself Shirdi Sai's reincarnation.

traditions.name: Brahma Kumaris
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Lekhraj Kripalani (Brahma Baba) after visions in 1936; headquartered at Mount Abu, Rajasthan.

traditions.name: ISKCON (Hare Krishna movement)
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada as a missionary branch of Gaudiya Vaishnavism (from Chaitanya, 16th c.).

traditions.name: Kemetic Orthodoxy
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Tamara Siuda (Hekatawy I) as a reconstruction of ancient Egyptian religion.

traditions.name: Rodnovery (Slavic Native Faith)
traditions.scholarly_note: Modern Slavic Paganism; the name means "native faith" and is often linked to Rod. Some groups rely on the Book of Veles, a text published in the 1950s that scholars regard as a modern forgery.

traditions.name: Native American Church
traditions.scholarly_note: Pan-Indian peyote religion; the Half Moon and Cross Fire (Big Moon) ceremonial ways differ on the role of the Bible.

traditions.name: Ghost Dance
traditions.geographic_origin: Nevada (Northern Paiute), spreading across the Plains
traditions.scholarly_note: Recorded by James Mooney, The Ghost-Dance Religion and the Sioux Outbreak of 1890 (1896).

traditions.name: Longhouse religion (Gaiwiio of Handsome Lake)
traditions.scholarly_note: The Good Message of the Seneca prophet Handsome Lake; recorded in Arthur C. Parker, The Code of Handsome Lake, the Seneca Prophet (1913).

traditions.name: Mami Wata veneration
traditions.geographic_origin: West and Central Africa, and the African diaspora
traditions.scholarly_note: A transnational water-spirit cult whose modern iconography took shape from the late 19th century.

traditions.name: Kimbanguism
traditions.scholarly_note: The Church of Jesus Christ on Earth by His Messenger Simon Kimbangu (EJCSK).

traditions.name: Nazareth Baptist Church (amaNazaretha)
traditions.scholarly_note: Founded by Isaiah Shembe; its holy places are Ekuphakameni and Mount Nhlangakazi.

traditions.name: Aladura churches
traditions.scholarly_note: "Praying people" (Yoruba): the Cherubim and Seraphim (1925), Christ Apostolic Church (1941) and Celestial Church of Christ (1947), among others.

traditions.name: Hòa Hảo
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1939 CE (roots in Bửu Sơn Kỳ Hương, 1849)
traditions.scholarly_note: A lay Buddhist reform founded by Huỳnh Phú Sổ in Hòa Hảo village, An Giang.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1961 CE (Betty and Barney Hill abduction account)
primary_sources: John G. Fuller, The Interrupted Journey (1966), on the Hill case
Budd Hopkins, Missing Time (1981) and Intruders (1987)
deities.summary: Small grey beings with large heads and great black almond eyes who visit human beings, take them aboard their craft, examine them and communicate mind to mind. For abductees and researchers they are the most frequently met of the visitors; some see them as cold experimenters, others as teachers warning humanity about its future.
deities.tradition_claim: Abductees and ufologists hold that the Greys are real physical or interdimensional visitors.

primary_sources: George Adamski & Desmond Leslie, Flying Saucers Have Landed (1953)
George Van Tassel, I Rode a Flying Saucer (1952)
deities.summary: Tall, fair, human-looking beings from Venus, other planets or the Pleiades who come in love to warn humanity against nuclear war and to teach a cosmic philosophy of brotherhood.

primary_sources: George Adamski & Desmond Leslie, Flying Saucers Have Landed (1953)
George Adamski, Inside the Space Ships (1955)
deities.summary: The Venusian who landed near Desert Center, California, on 20 November 1952 and spoke with George Adamski by gestures and telepathy, warning that atomic testing endangered the cosmos.

primary_sources: Truman Bethurum, Aboard a Flying Saucer (1954)
deities.summary: The woman captain of a scow-shaped craft from the planet Clarion, hidden behind the Moon, who met Truman Bethurum in the Nevada desert in 1952 and spoke of a peaceful world without war or illness.

primary_sources: Frank E. Stranges, Stranger at the Pentagon (1967)
deities.summary: A Venusian commander who, according to evangelist Frank Stranges, came to Washington in 1957, met President Eisenhower and lived for three years in the Pentagon, offering help to end disease and war.

primary_sources: David Icke, Children of the Matrix (2001)
deities.summary: Shape-shifting reptilian beings from another dimension or star system who rule humanity in secret through interbred bloodlines, feeding on fear.
deities.tradition_claim: David Icke identifies the Reptilians with the Anunnaki of Sumerian texts and with the Gnostic archons.

primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (Le Livre qui dit la vérité, 1974)
Raël, Extraterrestrials Took Me to Their Planet (1975)
Raël, Intelligent Design: Message from the Designers (2005)
deities.etymology: Raëlians read Hebrew Elohim (a plural form) as "those who came from the sky".
deities.summary: The Elohim are human scientists from another planet who created all life on Earth, including humanity in their image, by mastery of DNA in laboratories. The Bible's "Elohim", a plural, means "those who came from the sky"; they are not gods but our creators, and they wish to be welcomed openly in an embassy on Earth.
deities.tradition_claim: Raëlism is atheist: there is no God, only the Elohim as human-like creators, and an infinite universe.

alternate_names: Yahweh, President of the Council of the Eternals
primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (1974)
Raël, Extraterrestrials Took Me to Their Planet (1975)
deities.summary: Yahweh is the leader of the Elohim, president of the Council of the Eternals on their planet. He met Raël in 1973 and 1975 and revealed himself as Raël's biological father.

primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (1974)
Raël, Extraterrestrials Took Me to Their Planet (1975)
deities.summary: Claude Vorilhon, a French journalist, met an Eloha in the crater of Puy de Lassolas on 13 December 1973 and received the name Raël, "the messenger". He is the last of the prophets, the Guide of Guides, and in 1975 was taken to the planet of the Elohim, where he met Jesus, the Buddha, Moses and Muhammad.

primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (1974)
deities.summary: Lucifer was the leader of a group of Elohim scientists who loved their creation and told the first humans the truth: that they could become scientists like their creators. The "serpent" of Eden was this group, and for it they were exiled to Earth.

alternate_names: Satan, leader of the opposition on the Council
primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (1974)
deities.summary: Satan was the head of a faction of Elohim who believed humanity dangerous and pressed for its destruction; the Flood and Sodom were his faction's attempts.

primary_sources: Raël, The Book Which Tells the Truth (1974)
Raël, Extraterrestrials Took Me to Their Planet (1975)
deities.summary: Jesus was fathered by an Eloha with Mary and sent as a prophet to spread the creators' message; he was revived by the Elohim through cloning and now lives on their planet, where Raël met him.

primary_sources: How and When "Heaven's Gate" May Be Entered (anthology, 1996–1997)
deities.summary: Ti was the older member of the Next Level who came with Do as the "Two Witnesses"; she was Do's Father in the Kingdom and left her human vehicle in 1985, guiding the class from the Next Level until its departure in 1997.

primary_sources: How and When "Heaven's Gate" May Be Entered (1996–1997)
deities.summary: Do is the Representative from the Kingdom of Heaven, the same mind that incarnated in Jesus two thousand years ago, returned to offer the last chance to leave the human kingdom before Earth is "spaded under".

primary_sources: How and When "Heaven's Gate" May Be Entered (1996–1997)
deities.summary: The Kingdom of Heaven is a real, physical level above human, whose members are genderless, travel in spacecraft and once planted humanity as a garden; a human may enter it only by overcoming all mammalian attachment.

primary_sources: How and When "Heaven's Gate" May Be Entered (1996–1997)
deities.summary: Luciferians are fallen members of the Next Level, space aliens who keep humans bound to sex, religion and the cycle of the human kingdom so that they never reach the true Kingdom.

primary_sources: L. Ron Hubbard, Science of Survival (1951)
L. Ron Hubbard, Scientology: The Fundamentals of Thought (1956)
deities.summary: Life seeks survival across eight dynamics, from the self to the Supreme Being. The Eighth Dynamic is the urge toward existence as infinity; Scientology affirms a Supreme Being but leaves each person to reach his own understanding of it as he rises to the Seventh Dynamic.

A person does not have a soul; he is a thetan, an immortal spiritual being without mass or location in space and time, who created the physical universe (MEST) with other thetans and then became trapped in it, forgetting his own nature.

primary_sources: L. Ron Hubbard, OT III materials (1967; confidential, entered in court records)
L. Ron Hubbard, Revolt in the Stars (screenplay, 1977, unpublished)
deities.summary: In the church's confidential OT III teaching, Xenu was the ruler of a Galactic Confederacy of 76 planets who, 75 million years ago, solved overpopulation by bringing billions of beings to Earth (Teegeeack), placing them near volcanoes and destroying them with hydrogen bombs. Their captured souls were implanted with false images, including the roots of later religions, and clustered as body thetans.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1967–1978 CE (OT III and New Era Dianetics for OTs)
primary_sources: L. Ron Hubbard, OT III materials (1967)
L. Ron Hubbard, New Era Dianetics for OTs (1978)
deities.summary: Disembodied thetans from Xenu's incident cling in clusters to the bodies of living people; on the upper Operating Thetan levels a Scientologist audits them to release them.

deities.primary_name: Allah in the Person of Master W. Fard Muhammad
alternate_names: the Son of Man (Nation of Islam)
primary_sources: Elijah Muhammad, Message to the Blackman in America (1965)
Elijah Muhammad, Our Saviour Has Arrived (1974)
Nation of Islam, Supreme Wisdom lessons (1930s)
deities.summary: God is not a spook but a man. Allah came in the person of Master W. Fard Muhammad, who appeared in Detroit on 4 July 1930 to find and resurrect the Lost-Found Nation of Islam in the wilderness of North America, and taught Elijah Muhammad for three and a half years before departing in 1934. He is the long-awaited Mahdi and the Son of Man.
deities.tradition_claim: The Nation of Islam identifies W. Fard Muhammad as Allah incarnate; Sunni Islam regards this as incompatible with tawhid.

primary_sources: Elijah Muhammad, Message to the Blackman in America (1965)
Elijah Muhammad, The Fall of America (1973)
Elijah Muhammad, The Theology of Time (lectures, 1972)
deities.summary: Elijah Muhammad (1897–1975) was taught directly by Allah in the person of Master Fard Muhammad and raised up as his Messenger to the Black people of America, the last Messenger before the judgment of this world.

primary_sources: Elijah Muhammad, Message to the Blackman in America (1965), chapters on Yakub
Nation of Islam, Supreme Wisdom lessons (1930s)
deities.summary: Yakub was a brilliant Black scientist born 6,600 years ago near Mecca who, exiled with his followers to the island of Patmos, used selective breeding over centuries to graft a new race out of the Original People. That made people were given 6,000 years to rule, a period now ending.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1930s CE; taught by Elijah Muhammad to 1975
primary_sources: Elijah Muhammad, Message to the Blackman in America (1965)
Elijah Muhammad, The Fall of America (1973)
Louis Farrakhan, account of his vision at Tepotzotlán, 17 September 1985
deities.etymology: "Mother Plane" and "Mother Wheel" are Elijah Muhammad's terms; the identification with Ezekiel's ophanim is his reading.
deities.summary: The Mother Plane is a vast human-built craft, half a mile by half a mile, built by the Original scientists and carrying fifteen hundred smaller planes armed with bombs. It is the wheel that Ezekiel saw, and it will be the instrument of Allah's judgment on America. Minister Louis Farrakhan was carried up to it in a vision in 1985.

alternate_names: Allah the Father-God of the Universe
primary_sources: Noble Drew Ali, The Holy Koran of the Moorish Science Temple of America (Circle Seven Koran, 1927)
deities.summary: Allah is the Father-God of the Universe, the one God of love, truth, peace, freedom and justice, who sends his prophets to every nation; through Noble Drew Ali he restores to the Moorish Americans their nationality and their divine creed.

primary_sources: Noble Drew Ali, The Holy Koran of the Moorish Science Temple of America (1927)
deities.summary: Noble Drew Ali (1886–1929) is the prophet prepared by Allah to redeem the people of North America, who are Moors, descendants of the ancient Moabites, and to restore their nationality and their faith, Islamism.

deities.primary_name: The Black Man as God (Five Percent)
primary_sources: Supreme Mathematics and Supreme Alphabet (Five-Percent lessons)
deities.summary: There is no mystery god. The Original Black Man is God, and his proper name is ALLAH: Arm, Leg, Leg, Arm, Head. The Five Percent are the poor righteous teachers who know this and teach it, unlike the 85 percent who are deaf, dumb and blind and the 10 percent who teach false gods.

Clarence 13X (1928–1969), once a student minister of Mosque No. 7 in Harlem, taught that the Black man is God, took the attribute Allah, and gave the youth of Harlem the Supreme Mathematics and Alphabet.
The Original Woman is the Earth: as the Earth receives the Sun and gives life, she is the mother of civilization, partner of the God, and the one who brings forth the seed of the nation.

primary_sources: The Holy Bible (King James Version, read with Hebrew Israelite commentary)
Ben Ammi, God, the Black Man and Truth (1982)
deities.etymology: Forms such as Yahawah and Ahayah are movement renderings of the Tetragrammaton YHWH and of "ehyeh" (Exodus 3:14).
deities.summary: The Most High, whose true name is restored as Yahawah or Ahayah, is the God of Israel; the true children of Israel are the Black people of the Americas and Africa scattered by the curses of Deuteronomy 28, and he will gather and restore them.

Yahawashi, the Messiah, was a Black Israelite whose hair was like wool and feet like burnished brass. He is the Son of the Most High, who will return to free Israel and judge the nations that oppressed her.
deities.tradition_claim: Not all Hebrew Israelite groups accept Jesus; the African Hebrew Israelites of Jerusalem, for example, revere Yah without a divine Messiah. Yahawashi is the usage of camps such as Israel United in Christ.

deities.summary: Highly advanced beings from other planets of the solar system, governed by the Interplanetary Parliament on Saturn, who serve Earth in secret by transmitting spiritual energy, defending it from evil intelligences and giving teachings through their Primary Terrestrial Mental Channel, Sir George King.
A Cosmic Master from Venus who first spoke through George King in 1955 and gave his name to the Society; he delivers the teachings of the Interplanetary Parliament.

alternate_names: the Cosmic Master Jesus from Venus
deities.summary: Jesus is a Cosmic Master from Venus who came to Earth as an avatar two thousand years ago. In 1958 he gave the Twelve Blessings through George King on Holdstone Down, a new Sermon on the Mount for the Aquarian age.
The Earth is a living being of great spiritual evolution who suffers humanity on her surface while it learns; humanity owes her a karmic debt, repaid through prayer and spiritual energy sent to her.

alternate_names: Uriel: Universal Radiant Infinite Eternal Light
primary_sources: Ruth Norman, Preparation for the Landing (1987)
Ernest L. Norman & Ruth Norman, The Voice of Venus and related Unarius texts (1950s–1980s)
deities.summary: Ruth Norman (1900–1993) is the Archangel Uriel, whose name means Universal Radiant Infinite Eternal Light; she led Unarius after Ernest Norman's passing, prepared for the landing of the Space Brothers, and carried the healing light of past-life therapy.

primary_sources: Ernest L. Norman, The Infinite Concept of Cosmic Creation (1956)
Ernest L. Norman, The Voice of Venus (1956)
deities.summary: Ernest Norman (1904–1971) was the Archangel Raphael, the Moderator of Unarius, who in earlier lives had come as Jesus; he travelled in spirit to the higher worlds and brought back the science of life.

deities.primary_name: The Space Brothers of the Interplanetary Confederation
primary_sources: Ruth Norman, Preparation for the Landing (1987)
deities.summary: A confederation of thirty-two advanced planets that Earth will join as the thirty-third; their scientists were to land at Jamul, California, bringing the Unarius science and a new age.

primary_sources: George Van Tassel, I Rode a Flying Saucer (1952)
George Van Tassel, Into This World and Out Again (1956)
deities.summary: Ashtar is the commander of a vast fleet of spacecraft, the Ashtar Command, stationed around Earth under the spiritual direction of higher powers, to protect the planet and, if needed, to evacuate the faithful in a time of cataclysm.

primary_sources: Eduard Albert Meier, Contact Notes (Kontaktberichte, from 1975)
Wendelle Stevens, UFO… Contact from the Pleiades (1982)
deities.summary: A woman of the Plejaren from the planet Erra who met Billy Meier from 1975, taught him about Creation, spiritual evolution and Earth's dangers, and let him photograph her beamships.
Semjase's father and commander among the Plejaren, a wise elder who continued the contacts with Meier.

Jmmanuel is the true Jesus: a human prophet of Creation's laws, son of Mary by the celestial son Gabriel, who survived the crucifixion and died in old age in Kashmir. His teaching, distorted by the Gospels, is restored in the Talmud Jmmanuel.
There are no gods: there is Creation, the universal consciousness, whose laws and recommendations govern all life; every spirit-form is a fragment of Creation evolving toward union with it.

The Universal Father is God, the First Source and Center of all things, residing on Paradise at the center of the universe of universes, who indwells every normal mind with a fragment of himself, the Thought Adjuster.

The Eternal Son is the Second Person of the Paradise Trinity, the absolute expression of the Father's personality and the spiritual gravity of the universes; with the Infinite Spirit he begets the Michael Creator Sons.

The Infinite Spirit, the Conjoint Actor, is the Third Person of the Paradise Trinity, source of mind and of the ministering spirits; in each local universe it is represented by a Creative Mother Spirit.

Michael of Nebadon is the Creator Son who made and rules our local universe, Nebadon, from Salvington. His seventh and final bestowal was as Jesus of Nazareth on Urantia (Earth), by which he earned full sovereignty of his universe.

primary_sources: The Urantia Book (1955), Paper 53 (The Lucifer Rebellion)
deities.summary: Lucifer was a brilliant Lanonandek Son, sovereign of the local system of Satania, who some 200,000 years ago proclaimed a Declaration of Liberty denying the Universal Father and the authority of Michael, drawing thirty-seven planetary princes into rebellion.
Satan was Lucifer's first lieutenant, who carried the rebellion's message to the planets and visited Urantia; he confronted Jesus at Mount Hermon and was later detained.

Caligastia was the Planetary Prince of Urantia, who ruled Earth from his headquarters at Dalamatia half a million years ago and joined the Lucifer rebellion, plunging this world into isolation. He is the "devil" of human tradition.

Machiventa Melchizedek was a Melchizedek Son who incarnated in human form at Salem about 2,000 BCE to keep the light of monotheism alive; he taught Abraham and is now vicegerent Planetary Prince of Urantia.

deities.etymology: Hebrew malki-tsedeq, "my king is righteousness" or "king of righteousness".
deities.summary: Melchizedek, king of Salem and priest of El Elyon, brought out bread and wine and blessed Abram. In the Qumran Melchizedek scroll he is a heavenly figure, an elohim who proclaims liberty and executes judgment on Belial and his spirits in the last jubilee.

The wheels beside the living creatures in Ezekiel's vision, gleaming like beryl, a wheel within a wheel, their rims full of eyes, moving wherever the spirit goes. In 1 Enoch and later angelology they are a rank of angels who guard the throne of God, with the cherubim and seraphim.

deities.earliest_attestation: c. 2100 BCE (Gudea and Ur III texts)
deities.etymology: Sumerian a-nun-na, usually read "offspring of the prince (An)" or "princely seed".
deities.summary: The great gods, the offspring of An, who sit in assembly to decree the fates. In Atrahasis they are the senior gods who rule while the Igigi labour; in Inanna's Descent seven Anunnaki judge in the netherworld; in Enuma Elish Marduk divides them between heaven and the underworld.

The younger gods who once bore the toil of digging the rivers and canals for the Anunnaki; they rebelled, burned their tools and surrounded Enlil's house, and humanity was created from clay and a slain god's flesh and blood to take their labour.

deities.earliest_attestation: c. 290 BCE (Berossus); apkallu tradition 2nd millennium BCE
primary_sources: Berossus, Babyloniaca (fragments in Eusebius and Syncellus)
Bit Meseri incantation series (lists of the seven apkallu)
deities.summary: A creature with the body of a fish and the head and feet of a man who rose from the Erythraean Sea and taught humanity writing, the sciences, laws, temple-building and agriculture, returning to the sea each night; the first of the seven apkallu sages of Enki.

alternate_names: "those who from heaven to earth came"
primary_sources: Zecharia Sitchin, The Stairway to Heaven (1980)
Zecharia Sitchin, The Wars of Gods and Men (1985)
deities.summary: The Anunnaki are flesh-and-blood astronauts from the planet Nibiru who landed in Mesopotamia about 450,000 years ago to mine gold to repair their planet's atmosphere. When their workers rebelled, they genetically engineered Homo sapiens as a slave species; the Sumerians recorded them as their gods, and the Bible's Nefilim are the same beings.
deities.tradition_claim: A separate modern reading; Assyriologists reject Sitchin's translations. Never to be merged with the structural Mesopotamian Anunnaki.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1976 CE (Sitchin's reading); Nēberu attested in Enuma Elish VII
deities.etymology: Akkadian nēberu, "crossing (point)"; in Enuma Elish VII it is one of Marduk's names and an astral station.
deities.summary: Nibiru is the home planet of the Anunnaki, on a 3,600-year elliptical orbit through the solar system. The Babylonian Enuma Elish preserves its story as Marduk's battle with Tiamat: the incoming planet collided with Tiamat, forming the Earth and the asteroid belt.

primary_sources: Zecharia Sitchin, The Lost Book of Enki (2002)
deities.summary: Enki was the first Anunnaki leader to splash down on Earth, a chief scientist who, with Ninhursag, engineered the first humans, defied his half-brother Enlil to warn Ziusudra of the Flood, and acted as humanity's champion; he is the serpent of Eden.

primary_sources: Zecharia Sitchin, The Wars of Gods and Men (1985)
deities.summary: Enlil was Anu's legal heir and the commander of the Anunnaki mission on Earth, stern and distrustful of the humans; he decided to let the Flood destroy them, and his line later fought Enki's for control of Earth.
Anu was the king of Nibiru, father of Enki and Enlil, who visited Earth on state occasions and divided its rule between his sons.

primary_sources: Erich von Däniken, Erinnerungen an die Zukunft / Chariots of the Gods? (1968)
Erich von Däniken, Gods from Outer Space (1970)
Josef F. Blumrich, The Spaceships of Ezekiel (1974)
deities.summary: The gods of the ancients were space travellers who visited prehistoric Earth, taught technology, interbred with or altered human beings, and left traces in monuments such as the Nazca lines, the Pyramids, the Palenque sarcophagus lid and the visions of Ezekiel.

primary_sources: Robert K. G. Temple, The Sirius Mystery (1976)
Marcel Griaule & Germaine Dieterlen, Le Renard pâle (1965)
deities.summary: The Nommo were amphibious beings from a planet in the Sirius system who came to Earth in an ark thousands of years ago and taught the Dogon, Babylonians and Egyptians; this is why the Dogon knew of Sirius B, its fifty-year orbit and its density.

alternate_names: humble messengers of the Law of One
primary_sources: The Ra Material: An Ancient Astronaut Speaks (1984)
The Law of One, Books I–V (1982–1998)
deities.summary: Ra is a sixth-density social memory complex, once humans of Venus, who serve the One Infinite Creator. They walked among the Egyptians, taught Ikhnaton the Law of One, and helped build the Great Pyramid by thought; their message was distorted into a priesthood of the sun, and they return to correct it.

primary_sources: The Law of One, Books I–V
deities.summary: All things are one, and that one is the Infinite Creator, knowing itself through every entity; free will, love and light are its first distortions, and every being is the Creator experiencing itself.

primary_sources: The Law of One, Books I–II
deities.summary: Social memory complexes polarized toward service to self, the Orion group seek to enslave and control the peoples of Earth by calling elites to dominate, in contrast to the Confederation of Planets in the Service of the Infinite Creator.

deities.earliest_attestation: 712 CE (Kojiki); first deity to appear in the Nihon Shoki (720)
deities.summary: The Eternally Standing Kami of the Land, the first deity to appear in the Nihon Shoki's account of creation (in the Kojiki he appears after the first five heavenly kami). Medieval Ise (Watarai) Shinto and Yoshida Shinto exalted him as the primordial origin of all kami.

A dreaded wandering god of direction from Onmyōdō lore, whose position shifts by the calendar; building, moving or travelling toward his direction brought curse (tatari), and the northeast (ushitora) was his most feared quarter.

primary_sources: Ofudesaki (The Tip of the Writing Brush)
deities.summary: God the Parent, the true and original God who created human beings in a muddy ocean in order to see them live the Joyous Life and to share in that joy. God revealed this through Nakayama Miki, the Shrine of God, and the Jiba in Tenri marks the place of human conception.

primary_sources: The Life of Oyasama, Foundress of Tenrikyo
deities.summary: Nakayama Miki (1798–1887) became the Shrine of God on 26 October 1838. Through her mouth and brush God the Parent spoke; she withdrew from physical life in 1887 but is ever-living and continues to work for the salvation of the world.

alternate_names: the Great God of the Northeast
primary_sources: Deguchi Onisaburo, Reikai Monogatari (Tales of the Spirit World, 1921–1934)
deities.summary: Ushitora no Konjin, the God of the Northeast feared as a curse-bringer, is in truth Kunitokotachi, the original ruler of the world, who was confined to the northeast by gods of selfishness. He has returned through Deguchi Nao to proclaim the rebuilding and renewal of the world.
An illiterate widow of Ayabe (1837–1918) possessed by Ushitora no Konjin in 1892, who wrote some 200,000 pages of revelation, the Ofudesaki, in simple kana.

Co-founder of Oomoto (1871–1948), shaman and artist, who systematized Nao's revelation in the Tales of the Spirit World and in 1928 celebrated the Miroku Taisai, manifesting as Miroku (Maitreya), the bringer of the new world.

alternate_names: Tenchi Kane no Kami (Parent God of the Universe)
deities.summary: Tenchi Kane no Kami is the Parent God of heaven and earth, in whose blessing all people live. The god once feared as the curse-giving Konjin is, in truth, a loving Parent who suffers with humanity and wishes all to be helped.

Akazawa Bunji (1814–1883), a farmer who after illness surrendered to Konjin, was made Ikigami Konko Daijin, a living kami, and in 1859 began the mediation (toritsugi) of people's prayers to Tenchi Kane no Kami.

primary_sources: Taniguchi Masaharu, Seimei no Jissō (Truth of Life, 1932–)
Kanro no Hōu (The Nectar of Truth, holy sutra)
deities.summary: God is Life, Wisdom and Love, and only God's perfect creation truly exists. Matter, sickness and evil have no real existence; humans are children of God, already perfect in their True Image (Jissō). The religion's guiding god is enshrined as Sumiyoshi Ōkami.

primary_sources: Choe Je-u, Donggyeong Daejeon (Great Scripture of Eastern Learning)
Choe Je-u, Yongdam Yusa (Songs of Dragon Pool)
deities.summary: Hanullim, the Lord of Heaven, appeared to Choe Je-u in 1860 and gave him the Sacred Formula. Every person bears Hanullim within (si cheonju); as the later teaching says, "humans are Heaven" (in nae cheon), so serve people as you serve Heaven.
Choe Je-u (1824–1864) received the revelation of Hanullim on 5 April 1860 and founded Donghak; he was executed in 1864 by the Joseon government and is honored as the Great Divine Teacher.

Kang Il-sun is Sangje, the Supreme God of the Ninth Heaven, who descended in human form in Korea to perform the Reordering Works of Heaven and Earth (Cheonji Gongsa), resolving the grievances accumulated since ancient times and opening the Later World of mutual beneficence.

primary_sources: The Scriptures of Won Buddhism (Wonbulgyo Kyojeon, 1962)
deities.summary: Il-Won-Sang, the unitary circle, is the Dharmakaya Buddha, the original source of all beings and the Buddha-nature of every sentient being; Won Buddhists enshrine the circle, not a statue, as the object of faith and the model of practice.

Pak Chung-bin (1891–1943) attained great enlightenment on 28 April 1916 and taught that "as material civilization develops, cultivate spiritual civilization accordingly"; he is the founding Buddha of the new era.

Zhen-Shan-Ren, Truthfulness, Compassion and Forbearance, is the fundamental characteristic of the universe, the Buddha Fa that created all things. A practitioner who assimilates to it cultivates xinxing and receives the Falun, a rotating Law Wheel installed in the lower abdomen.

Master Li Hongzhi introduced Falun Dafa to the public in 1992; practitioners hold that his Law Bodies watch over and protect every genuine practitioner and that he cleanses their bodies and installs the Falun.

primary_sources: Exposition of the Divine Principle (Wolli Kangron, 1966)
deities.summary: God is the Heavenly Parent, the harmonious union of dual characteristics, masculinity and femininity, internal character and external form. God created humans as children to realize the Four Position Foundation and a world of true love, and has grieved throughout history over the Fall.

Sun Myung Moon (1920–2012) and Hak Ja Han are the True Parents of humankind: the Lord of the Second Advent and his bride, who accomplished the mission left unfinished by Adam and Eve and by Jesus, and through the Blessing engraft humanity onto God's lineage.

primary_sources: Exposition of the Divine Principle (1966), Part I, Chapter 2 (The Human Fall)
deities.summary: Lucifer was the archangel of love who, feeling less loved than Adam and Eve, seduced Eve into an illicit spiritual union; Eve then joined with Adam prematurely, and humanity inherited Satan's lineage instead of God's.

Sugmad is God, the formless, all-embracing Ocean of Love and Mercy, beyond all worlds, neither masculine nor feminine. Soul is a spark of Sugmad and returns through the ECK to the Ocean of Love and Mercy as a co-worker with God.

alternate_names: the Light and Sound of God
primary_sources: Paul Twitchell, ECKANKAR: The Key to Secret Worlds (1969)
deities.summary: The ECK is the Holy Spirit, the Audible Life Current flowing out from Sugmad as Light and Sound and returning to it; Soul rides this wave home. HU is the ancient name of God sung to attune to it.

deities.primary_name: The Mahanta, the Living ECK Master
deities.summary: The Mahanta is the highest state of God Consciousness on Earth, embodied in the Living ECK Master of the time, who links Soul with the ECK and guides it inwardly through the dream worlds and Soul Travel.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1965 CE (Eckankar); earlier in Sant Mat and the Kabir Panth
deities.summary: Kal Niranjan is the negative power, ruler of the lower worlds of matter, energy, space and time. Sugmad permits him to test Soul through illusion and the passions until it is purified; Soul escapes his realm through the ECK.

primary_sources: Paul Twitchell, Stranger by the River (1970)
deities.summary: A Tibetan ECK Master said to be over five hundred years old, who lives in a hut in the Hindu Kush and trained Paul Twitchell; he is one of the Vairagi Adepts of the Order of the ECK Masters.

primary_sources: Oahspe: A New Bible in the Words of Jehovih and His Angel Embassadors (1882)
deities.etymology: Oahspe explains the name as the sounds E-O-Ih made by the wind; it is evidently modelled on "Jehovah".
deities.summary: Jehovih is the Creator, the All Person, the Ever Present, whose name echoes the sound of the wind (E-O-Ih). Under him angels and gods, once mortals, administer the heavens of the Earth in cycles; the Kosmon era begun in 1848 is the age of peace in which humans speak directly with Jehovih.

Meher Baba (1894–1969) is the Avatar of the age, the Ancient One who has come again and again as Zoroaster, Rama, Krishna, the Buddha, Jesus and Muhammad. He kept silence from 10 July 1925 until his death, saying "I have come not to teach but to awaken".

primary_sources: Hemadpant (G. R. Dabholkar), Shri Sai Satcharita (1929)
deities.summary: A fakir of unknown birth who lived in a mosque he called Dwarakamayi in Shirdi until 1918, honored by Hindus and Muslims alike. He said "Sabka Malik Ek" (one God governs all) and taught faith (shraddha) and patience (saburi); devotees regard him as a perfect master and an incarnation of the divine.

Sathya Sai Baba (1926–2011) of Puttaparthi declared in 1940 that he was Sai Baba of Shirdi returned, and in 1963 that he was Shiva and Shakti incarnate, the second of three Sai avatars, to be followed by Prema Sai. He taught Sathya, Dharma, Shanti, Prema and Ahimsa and the unity of all faiths.

God is Shiv Baba, the incorporeal Supreme Soul, a point of infinite light residing in the soul world (Paramdham) beyond the sun, moon and stars. He never takes birth but enters the body of Brahma to give knowledge and Raja Yoga at the end of the cycle, transforming the Iron Age into the Golden Age.

Lekhraj Kripalani (1876–1969), a diamond merchant of Hyderabad, Sindh, received visions of Vishnu, of destruction and of a new world in 1936; Shiv Baba chose his body as the chariot through which to speak, and he became Prajapita Brahma, father of the new human race.

alternate_names: Krishna, the Supreme Personality of Godhead
primary_sources: A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada, Bhagavad-gītā As It Is (1968; 1972)
deities.summary: Krishna is not an avatar of Vishnu but the source of all avatars, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, eternally sporting in Goloka Vrindavana with Radha. Pure devotional service (bhakti) and chanting the Hare Krishna mahamantra revive the soul's eternal relationship with him.

Chaitanya Mahaprabhu is Krishna himself in the mood and golden complexion of Radha, who appeared in Navadvipa, Bengal, in 1486 to taste Radha's love for Krishna and to inaugurate the congregational chanting of the holy names (sankirtana) as the religion of this age.

primary_sources: Pyramid Texts and later Egyptian hymns (as reconstructed sources)
deities.summary: Netjer is God, one and many: the divine power that appears in its many Names, the netjeru such as Ra, Aset (Isis), Wesir (Osiris) and Set. Each member is divined to a parent Name, and the Nisut (Hekatawy I) serves as the bridge between Netjer and the community.

primary_sources: Rodnover community creeds (e.g. Union of Slavic Native Belief Communities)
deities.summary: Rod is the supreme God, the universal source of all gods, nature and kin; the gods are his faces and powers, and the ancestors and descendants are bound in Rod. Native faith (Rodnoverie) is the faith of one's Rod, one's kin.
In Lev Sylenko's Native Ukrainian National Faith, Dazhboh is the one God, the living, giving force of the universe and the light of the Ukrainian spirit; the old gods were his aspects.

primary_sources: James Mooney, testimony at the U.S. House of Representatives hearings on peyote (1918)
Native American Church ceremonial practice (Half Moon and Cross Fire ways)
deities.summary: Peyote is the holy medicine given by the Creator to Indian people, a sacrament through which the Creator's power heals, teaches and comforts. In an all-night tipi meeting led by a roadman, around the crescent altar and the fire, the medicine opens prayer.

primary_sources: James Mooney, The Ghost-Dance Religion and the Sioux Outbreak of 1890 (1896), including Wovoka's Messiah Letter
deities.summary: Wovoka (c. 1856–1932), a Northern Paiute holy man of Mason Valley, Nevada, died and was taken to the other world during the solar eclipse of 1 January 1889. God showed him the dead living happily, and told him to teach the people to dance, to love one another, work and not fight, so that the dead would return and the earth be renewed.

primary_sources: Arthur C. Parker, The Code of Handsome Lake, the Seneca Prophet (1913)
deities.summary: Handsome Lake (c. 1735–1815), a Seneca sachem near death, was visited by four messengers of the Creator in June 1799 and taken on a sky journey. He brought back the Gaiwiio, the Good Message: give up whiskey, witchcraft, love magic and abortion, keep the ceremonies, and care for family.

primary_sources: Arthur C. Parker, The Code of Handsome Lake (1913)
deities.summary: The Creator who made the earth and all life and gave the Haudenosaunee their ceremonies; grieved by drunkenness and witchcraft, he sent his four messengers to Handsome Lake.

primary_sources: Arthur C. Parker, The Code of Handsome Lake (1913)
deities.summary: Four men dressed in fine clothes, carrying bows and berry bushes, who appeared to Handsome Lake as messengers of the Creator and guided him on his journey through the sky.

primary_sources: Arthur C. Parker, The Code of Handsome Lake (1913)
deities.summary: The master of the house of torment at the fork of the sky road, who punishes drunkards, witches, wife-beaters and gamblers with torments matched to their sins.

deities.earliest_attestation: late 19th c. CE (modern iconography); older water-spirit cults
primary_sources: Mami Wata shrine practice (Togo, Benin, Nigeria, Ghana, DR Congo)
deities.summary: Mami Wata, "Mother Water", is a beautiful foreign water spirit, half woman and half fish or crowned with a snake, who brings wealth, beauty, healing and children to those she chooses, demanding fidelity, cleanliness and gifts of perfume, mirrors and sweets in return.

Simon Kimbangu (c. 1887–1951) of Nkamba began healing and preaching in April 1921 and was imprisoned by the Belgian colonial authorities for thirty years until his death. Kimbanguists honor him as the envoy of Jesus Christ and the Holy Spirit, the Comforter promised in John 14, sent to Black Africa.

Isaiah Shembe (c. 1865–1935), healer and prophet, was sent by Jehova to the Zulu; he founded Ekuphakameni and the pilgrimage to Mount Nhlangakazi, kept the Sabbath, composed the church's hymns, and is honored by the faithful as a divine messenger and liberator through whom the Spirit speaks.

alternate_names: Saint Michael the Archangel (Cherubim and Seraphim)
primary_sources: Cherubim and Seraphim church order and hymnody
deities.summary: In the Cherubim and Seraphim and related Aladura churches, the Archangel Michael is the captain of the heavenly host who leads the church's spiritual warfare against witches and evil powers, invoked in prayer, vision and the white-robed processions.

primary_sources: Huỳnh Phú Sổ, Sấm Giảng Thi Văn (Oracles and Teachings)
deities.summary: Huỳnh Phú Sổ (1920–1947) was cured of illness on a mountain pilgrimage and began in 1939 to heal and preach a simple lay Buddhism of worship at home before a plain brown cloth, honoring the Buddha, ancestors, country and humanity, and preparing for the coming age of the Long Hoa assembly.

alternate_names: Buddha Master of the Western Peace
primary_sources: Huỳnh Phú Sổ, Sấm Giảng Thi Văn
deities.summary: Đoàn Minh Huyên (1807–1856), healer during the cholera of 1849 and founder of Bửu Sơn Kỳ Hương ("Strange Fragrance from the Precious Mountain"), is revered by Hòa Hảo followers as the Buddha Master of the Western Peace, the first of their line of masters.

facets.facet_name: The visitors who take humans aboard
facets.core_claim: The Greys come at night, paralyse their subjects, carry them through walls into their craft and examine them. They are beings from elsewhere whose intentions remain veiled; witnesses return with missing time and fragments of their message.
facets.scholarly_note: The Hill case (1961) and its hypnosis sessions shaped the type; the image became fixed in popular culture through Communion (1987). Hanegraaff (1996) places the visitor experience alongside New Age channeling.

facets.core_claim: Abductees report that the Greys take eggs and sperm and show them hybrid children, a breeding program whose purpose is to save or replace the visitors' own failing race.
The Space Brothers are spiritually advanced humans of other worlds who watch over Earth, contact chosen messengers, and teach universal law and peace.
They come because the atomic bomb threatens not only Earth but the harmony of the solar system; humanity must turn from war or perish.
Orthon, a beautiful long-haired man from Venus, came to Adamski to deliver the Space Brothers' warning and to show that the planets are inhabited by brothers of humanity.

facets.facet_name: Captain from the hidden planet Clarion
facets.core_claim: Aura Rhanes commands a ship from Clarion; she came to tell Earth that her people live without war, taxes or disease, and that Earth could do the same.
Valiant Thor came from Venus as an envoy of a Christian-minded higher world to offer humanity healing and peace; Earth's leaders refused his offer.
Behind human institutions stand reptilian entities who interbred with chosen families and keep humanity in a prison of perception, harvesting its fear.
Twenty-five thousand years ago the Elohim came to Earth and synthesized every living thing in laboratories; Genesis is a garbled record of their scientific creation.
The Elohim will return openly once humanity builds them an embassy and renounces violence; Raël was sent to prepare it.

facets.facet_name: President of the Council of the Eternals
facets.core_claim: Yahweh presides over the Eternals, the Elohim who earned immortality by cloning; the "God" of the Bible was this leader and his team.
Yahweh fathered Raël with a human woman, as the Elohim fathered Jesus, so that the last messenger would be a son of the creators.
Raël is the final prophet of the age of Apocalypse (revelation), sent to explain the truth of creation in scientific terms and to build the embassy.
Raël identifies himself as the Maitreya awaited by Buddhists, coming from the West.
Lucifer's team, exiled with their creatures, gave humanity science and secretly fathered children with human women; the light they brought was knowledge.
Satan argued in the Council that creatures made in the creators' image would be violent and should be destroyed; he is not a devil but a cautious political opponent.

facets.facet_name: Half-Eloha prophet now living on the creators' planet
facets.core_claim: Jesus is Raël's half-brother, a son of the creators sent to prepare humanity; his "resurrection" was the Elohim's science.
Ti is an Older Member of the Evolutionary Level Above Human, Do's own Father, who incarnated to open the way and awaited the class aboard the spacecraft.
The Representative who was in Jesus came back in Do to lead a class of students out of their human vehicles into the Next Level.
With the comet Hale-Bopp as the sign, Do led his students to leave their bodies and board the craft that would take them to the Next Level.

facets.facet_name: The physical Kingdom of Heaven above human
facets.core_claim: The Next Level is the true heaven: an evolutionary kingdom of beings with incorruptible bodies who tend the "garden" of Earth and harvest those who are ready.

facets.facet_name: Fallen space aliens who bind humanity
facets.core_claim: The Luciferians fell from the Next Level and, through false religions and the pull of the body, hold humanity under their control.
The Eighth Dynamic, symbolized by the infinity sign standing upright, is the urge toward existence as infinity, the Supreme Being; it is approached, not dictated.

facets.facet_name: The immortal spiritual being that each person is
facets.core_claim: Each of us is a thetan, a being of pure theta, the static of life, who postulated space, energy and time into being and can recover full spiritual ability as an Operating Thetan.
Xenu was a galactic overlord who killed his own population on Earth and implanted their spirits with deceptions; he was finally captured and imprisoned in a mountain by loyal officers.
facets.scholarly_note: The church treats this material as confidential advanced scripture for members who have completed lower levels. It became public through court filings, notably in the 1985 Christofferson case in Portland and the 1993 affidavit of Steven Fishman, and later internet postings.

facets.core_claim: Xenu's implants showed the captured thetans false pictures of God, the Devil, angels and crucifixion; humanity's religions carry the residue of this deception.

facets.facet_name: Disembodied spirits clinging to the body
facets.core_claim: Body thetans, stunned and confused since the incident 75 million years ago, attach to a person and burden him until they are audited and set free.
Allah is a living man of supreme wisdom; he came in the person of Master Fard Muhammad to resurrect the so-called Negro from mental death and to judge the world.

facets.facet_name: The Mahdi and Son of Man
facets.core_claim: Master Fard Muhammad is the Mahdi of Muslim expectation and the Son of Man of the Gospels, come in the last days.
Elijah Muhammad received the Supreme Wisdom from God in person and delivered it as the Messenger: self-knowledge, separation, and the coming fall of America.

facets.facet_name: Scientist who grafted a new people
facets.core_claim: Yakub, "the big-headed scientist", rebelled against the Original Nation and by an exacting breeding law on Patmos made a new people to rule the world for a fixed time.
facets.scholarly_note: Yakub's name is the Arabic form of Jacob. The narrative is a distinctive Nation of Islam myth of origins (Message to the Blackman, 1965) and is rejected by Sunni Muslims and by Warith Deen Mohammed's reformed community.

facets.core_claim: Ezekiel's wheel within a wheel is the Mother Plane: a human-made planet of war circling above, which will destroy the wicked and deliver the righteous.

facets.facet_name: Father-God of love, truth, peace, freedom and justice
facets.core_claim: Allah is the Father of all humanity, worshiped under the five principles of Love, Truth, Peace, Freedom and Justice.
As Jesus was sent to Israel and Muhammad to the Arabs, Allah sent Noble Drew Ali, the last prophet in these days, to the Asiatics of America.

facets.facet_name: Living God in the Original Man
facets.core_claim: God is the Black man himself, made manifest when he knows himself through Supreme Mathematics; there is no spook in the sky.

facets.facet_name: Father who taught the Five Percent
facets.core_claim: Allah the Father showed that God is not hidden but walks the streets of Harlem in the Black man, and made the youth into gods and earths.
The Earth is the Black woman, who reflects the light of the God as the Moon reflects the Sun and bears the future of the nation.
The Most High chose Israel, and the so-called Negroes, Hispanics and Native Americans are that Israel; the slave ships fulfilled Deuteronomy 28:68, and their redemption is at hand.
Yahawashi died for Israel and will return to establish the kingdom of Israel and to punish their oppressors.
The Cosmic Masters of Saturn, Venus, Mars and Jupiter have passed beyond the need for rebirth and work for Earth's salvation, sending energy through spacecraft such as Satellite No. 3.

facets.facet_name: Venusian teacher of the Interplanetary Parliament
facets.core_claim: Master Aetherius speaks from Venus through Sir George King, calling humanity to service as the highest form of religion.

facets.facet_name: Venusian Master who came as Jesus
facets.core_claim: Jesus came from Venus as a Master of love and returned in 1958 to give the Twelve Blessings, including the blessing of Mother Earth.

facets.facet_name: Earth as a living, evolved being
facets.core_claim: Mother Earth is a great intelligence who could ascend but remains for humanity's sake; we must send her healing energy through Operation Prayer Power.
Uriel came to Earth as Ruth Norman to heal humanity of its past-life traumas and to welcome the Interplanetary Confederation.
Raphael incarnated as Ernest Norman to teach the Unarius science of energy and healing, and had once incarnated as Jesus of Nazareth.
The Space Brothers of the Confederation will land and welcome Earth into the fellowship of enlightened worlds.
Ashtar speaks to channels on Earth on behalf of the fleet, warning against nuclear war and promising rescue of the light-workers when the changes come.
Semjase came from the Pleiades region to teach the truth of Creation's laws, so that humanity might evolve in spirit rather than worship gods.
Ptaah oversees the Plejaren mission to Earth and answers Meier on history, science and the destiny of humankind.
Jmmanuel taught no god but Creation, and was fathered by a celestial guardian; his true words were found in a scroll in his tomb.
Creation is the highest power in the universe, impersonal and lawful; "god" is a title for rulers and should not be worshiped.
God is the Universal Father, infinite and personal, from whom all reality flows; he sends a Mystery Monitor to dwell in each human mind.
A pre-personal fragment of the Father, the Thought Adjuster, lives within each person and guides the soul toward fusion with God.

facets.facet_name: Second Person of the Paradise Trinity
facets.core_claim: The Eternal Son is the Word of God, the spiritual center that draws all spirit toward Paradise.
The Infinite Spirit acts for the Father and the Son, bestowing mind and ministering to all creatures through the Mother Spirit of each local universe.

facets.facet_name: Creator Son and sovereign of the local universe
facets.core_claim: Michael created Nebadon with the Mother Spirit and incarnated seven times in the likeness of his creatures, the last as Jesus.
Jesus of Nazareth was Michael living a human life, revealing the Father's love and ending the Lucifer rebellion's claims.
Lucifer denied that the Father exists, demanded self-assertion for every world and seized his system; after Michael's bestowal his rebellion was adjudicated and he was removed.
Satan advocated Lucifer's cause from world to world and tempted Jesus; his authority ended with Michael's bestowal.
Caligastia betrayed his trust, so that Urantia was quarantined from the communications of the universe; this is the "fall" behind human legends of the devil.
Machiventa came in the flesh as priest-king of Salem, made covenant with Abraham, and prepared the world for Michael's bestowal.
Melchizedek is priest of God Most High, without recorded genealogy, a priest forever; his blessing marks Abram.

facets.facet_name: Heavenly judge of the final jubilee
facets.core_claim: In 11Q13 Melchizedek stands in the divine council as an elohim, frees the captives and avenges God's judgment on Belial.
The ophanim move with the living creatures and bear the throne of the Glory; their eyes see in every direction, and the spirit of the creatures is in the wheels.

facets.facet_name: Assembly of the great gods who decree fate
facets.core_claim: The Anunnaki gather in assembly under An and Enlil to decide destinies; they judge the dead and the living alike.

facets.facet_name: Labouring gods whose strike caused humanity's creation
facets.core_claim: When the gods were like men and bore the work, the Igigi rose against Enlil; Enki answered by having humanity made to carry the yoke of the gods.
Oannes came up from the sea in the first days and taught every art of civilized life, after which nothing further was invented.
The gods of Sumer were not myths but visitors from the twelfth planet, ruling Earth from their spaceports and cities.
To relieve their miners, the Anunnaki mixed their own genes with those of an Earth hominid and created the Adamu, the first human.

facets.facet_name: The wandering planet of the gods
facets.core_claim: Nibiru, the "planet of crossing", returns every 3,600 years; its first passage shattered Tiamat and seeded Earth with life.
Enki and Ninhursag made the Adamu in the laboratory at the Abzu, mixing Anunnaki and hominid genes.
Enki gave humanity knowledge and saved it from the Flood that Enlil allowed; the biblical serpent remembers him.

facets.facet_name: Stern commander of the Earth mission
facets.core_claim: Enlil ruled Earth from Nippur's mission control and, wary of the hybrid humans, ordered the Anunnaki to let the Deluge take them.
Anu reigned on Nibiru and came to Earth only when the planet passed close, presiding over his sons' disputes.
Every people remembers gods who came from the sky in fire and taught them; these were astronauts, and the myths are eyewitness reports.

facets.facet_name: Sons of heaven who altered humanity
facets.core_claim: Genesis 6, where the sons of God took human wives, records the visitors' intervention in human heredity.
The Nommo descended from Sirius in a spinning vessel and brought civilization, remembered by the Dogon as the Nommo and by the Babylonians as Oannes.
facets.scholarly_note: Temple built on Griaule and Dieterlen's Dogon ethnography. A later field restudy among the Dogon did not find the Sirius B lore, and critics suggest contamination from 20th-century contacts; the reading remains contested.

facets.facet_name: Sixth-density collective, messenger of the Law of One
facets.core_claim: We are Ra, a group consciousness that once walked among the Egyptians; we come again to speak of the Law of One, that all is one.

facets.facet_name: Contacts of Ikhnaton and pyramid builders
facets.core_claim: Ra approached the pharaoh Ikhnaton, who accepted the Law of One, but after his death the teaching was lost and the name Ra became a god of the sun.
Intelligent infinity, the One Creator, becomes many through free will so as to know itself; all return to it through the densities.
The Orion crusaders answer the calls of those who seek power over others, offering control in exchange for service to self.
Kuni-no-Tokotachi arose first when heaven and earth separated, self-generated and hidden, the ground on which the land stands forever.
